_about: Second fresh answer test set, written after the retrieval change (heading kept in each passage text; up to two passages per source first). Every must_mention fact was checked by search to appear in the corpus. None of these questions was used to tune retrieval. Do not change a question or its facts after a run. The negative control (should_be_not_found) checks the model refuses when the sources do not answer.
